## ReadKeys type

The keys `read` takes for entity `N`<!-- -->: one, or a list. A key that may be an array is given in a list, so that one key is never read as several. None for a name that may be one of several entities (`cond ? "track" : "artist"`<!-- -->), whose key type is not one, nor for a graph whose type does not say its entities.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ReadKeys<E extends Entities, N extends keyof E> = IsUnion<N> extends true ? never : [ReadKey<E, N>] extends [never] ? never : [Extract<ReadKey<E, N>, readonly unknown[]>] extends [never] ? never[] extends ReadKey<E, N> ? readonly ReadKey<E, N>[] : ReadKey<E, N> | readonly ReadKey<E, N>[] : readonly ReadKey<E, N>[];
```
